uv: an existing multi line array with a trailing comma gets a new item on its own line.
-- changes --
[{"name":"urllib3","ecosystem":"pypi","to":"2.2.2","method":"override","file":"pyproject.toml"}]
-- in:pyproject.toml --
[project]
name = "app"
dependencies = ["requests>=2.31"]

[tool.uv]
dev-dependencies = ["pytest"]
override-dependencies = [
    "idna==3.7",
    "certifi==2024.2.2",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
-- out:pyproject.toml --
[project]
name = "app"
dependencies = ["requests>=2.31"]

[tool.uv]
dev-dependencies = ["pytest"]
override-dependencies = [
    "idna==3.7",
    "certifi==2024.2.2",
    "urllib3==2.2.2",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
